narrative.overview: A real photographed object owns a midnight field. Small, icy text and attached inspection markers let physical detail carry the presence. This replaces the abandoned ocean identity; the directory name is historical.
keyCharacteristics: Real photographic detail, not decorative circuit paths.

rules.name: The Contrast Ground Rule
rules.body: All annotation labels have an opaque midnight or ice backing, never unprotected copy over photograph detail.

dos: Do disclose representative photography and attribution visibly.
Do attach inspection points to physical components, using factual sources.
donts: Don't imply photographed hardware belongs to Victor.
Don't substitute routing, alignment, semantic habitats or a slider for inspection.
